response.sql: WITH color_totals AS (SELECT p.product_color, SUM(ili.derived_total_cost) AS invoiced_amount FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili JOIN Products AS p ON p.product_id = ili.product_id GROUP BY p.product_color), color_metrics AS (SELECT invoiced_amount, 1.0 * invoiced_amount / NULLIF(SUM(invoiced_amount) OVER (), 0) AS share_of_total, AVG(invoiced_amount) OVER () AS average_per_color FROM color_totals) SELECT AVG(invoiced_amount) AS average_invoiced_amount, AVG(share_of_total) AS average_share, AVG(invoiced_amount - average_per_color) AS average_amount_above_per_color_average FROM color_metrics WHERE invoiced_amount > average_per_color;
